proposals.premise: The three records come from the same bend. Visitors looking for its history can follow a dated sequence from the ferry photo to the river walk.
proposals.opening: On desktop, the 1932 photo and its unverified photographer note sit beside a year index. On phones, the three year buttons sit above the photo and note.
proposals.move: Select 1978 to open the scan in the same viewer, with its east abutment caption. Select 2025 for playback and the transcript.
proposals.tradeoff: Dates make records easy to find, while comparing sources takes switching between years.

proposals.premise: Visitors may expect to match the ferry photo to the bend they know. Its changed shape makes the recorded locations a better starting point for comparison.
proposals.opening: Desktop opens with the east abutment scan beside a public steps audio panel. Phones stack the scan and audio panel beneath a shared caption about the bend.
proposals.move: Choose Compare with 1932 to reveal the ferry photo and its unverified photographer note below both sources. Playback and transcript controls stay in the audio panel.
proposals.tradeoff: The opening makes the two documented locations easy to compare. The ferry photo takes one extra step.
